blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY — Around 300 kilograms of garbage were collected from mangrove and coastal areas in Malapatan town, Sarangani province, during a cleanup led by the Department of Environment and Natural Resources – Region 12 (DENR-12) and the municipal government. DENR-12’s Provincial Environment and Natural Resources Office (PENRO) in Sarangani and Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) in Glan, together with other government agencies and volunteers, carried out the cleanup. PENRO-Sarangani head Joy Ologuin said on Monday the cleanup was part of efforts to protect and maintain the mangrove areas. READ: PH coastal cleanup yields 466,000 kg of trash nationwide […]...
